description: Configure Screaming Frog SEO Spider to extract HTTP response headers from https://crawler-test.com/ using the 'Custom Extraction' feature (HTTP Header mode). Specifically, extract the 'Server' header (name it 'Server_Header'), the 'Content-Type' header (name it 'Mime_Type'), and the 'Date' header (name it 'Response_Date'). After crawling at least 20 URLs, export the results to '~/Documents/SEO/exports/header_audit.csv'. Finally, analyze the data and write a short text report to '~/Documents/SEO/reports/server_fingerprint.txt' identifying the web server software (e.g., Nginx, Apache) and the count of unique content types found.
